'''Wunka''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] who fought alongside his brother [[Tokkat/Legends|Tokkat]] in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Biography==
Wunka played a crucial part in the battle aiding in the hijacking of an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]]. This act changed the tide of battle in favor of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The two brothers survived the battle.

[[File:WillyWunkaChewie.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Widdle Warrick/Legends|Widdle Warrick]], Wunka and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].]]
After the battle, he and Tokkat traveled off their homeworld of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The brothers eventually took positions as gunners on the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Liberator (Imperial I-class)|''Liberator'']]. Tokkat and Wunka were present when the ''Liberator'' [[Second Battle of Coruscant|crashed]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They bravely defended the surviving crew on the ground.<ref name="GatORW" />

Wunka was later killed in a [[Skirmish on Holageus]], and Tokkat took his body back to Endor for burial.<ref name="GatORW" />

==Behind the scenes==
An action figure of Wunka was released in [[August]] [[2012]] as part of a K-Mart exclusive 2-pack of Ewok Scouts.
